🎶 Listen Now On 📲 🤳 Spotify  - https://open.spotify.com/track/4LMlVCXHJtCE9abhmn0mYo?si=ec8a6d106a054b63

If you’ve ever been heartbroken, then this one’s for you. 
Pal Pal’s about being stuck in that loop where all you want is that one person and the angst that comes with it.
